title: Composition of relative-section logarithmic morphisms
statement: For arbitrary schemes with etale log structures and relative-section log morphisms [def-trf-log-ideal-chart-presentation], define the composite of $f:(X,L)\to(Y,M)$ and $g:(Y,M)\to(Z,N)$ as follows. Its scheme map is $g\circ f$. For a compatible relative etale diagram $V\to W$ over this composite, put $U=Y\times_Z W$, factor $V\to W$ canonically through $U$, and define its section homomorphism to be the homomorphism of $g$ on $W\leftarrow U$ followed by that of $f$ on $U\leftarrow V$.

source.place: ILO VI 1.1, p.69 (log-morphism conventions); Kato 1988 section 1; existing relative-section construction in LogMorphismOperations.
